command:
/work/clock
cat /work/skill/SKILL.md
ls -la /work

cd /work/crate
rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CLAUDE.md' -g '*POLICY*' -g '*CONTRIBUTING*' -g '*toolchain*' -g '*clippy*' -g '*rustfmt*'

cat /work/skill/references/audit-checklist.md /work/skill/references/errors.md /work/skill/references/testing.md

cd /work/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
cargo test --locked -p quinn-proto > /work/tmp/baseline-test.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -80 /work/tmp/baseline-test.log
exit "$status"

find . -type f \( -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -o -name AI_POLICY.md -o -name CONTRIBUTING.md -o -name rust-toolchain.toml -o -name clippy.toml \)

cat quinn-proto/src/lib.rs

export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
bash /work/skill/scripts/check.sh --audit /work/crate > /work/tmp/gate.log 2>&1

tail -100 /work/tmp/gate.log
exit "$status"

export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
rustc -Vv
rustup toolchain list
rustup target list --installed
find .github/workflows -type f
python3 -I /work/skill/scripts/audit_scan.py /work/crate/quinn-proto > /work/tmp/scan.log 2>&1

wc -l quinn-proto/src/**/*.rs quinn-proto/src/*.rs

cat quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/recv.rs

cd /work/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
cargo clippy --locked -p quinn-proto --all-targets --features qlog,arbitrary,platform-verifier,rustls-log -- -D warnings > /work/tmp/clippy.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -100 /work/tmp/clippy.log
exit "$status"

cd /work/crate
sed -n '1,350p' quinn-proto/src/connection/assembler.rs
cat quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/send.rs
sed -n '1,240p' quinn-proto/src/tests/util.rs

du -sh /work/crate

export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --locked -p quinn-proto --no-deps --document-private-items --features qlog,arbitrary,platform-verifier,rustls-log > /work/tmp/doc.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -60 /work/tmp/doc.log
exit "$status"

cd /work/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
cargo clippy --locked -p quinn-proto --lib --features qlog,arbitrary,platform-verifier,rustls-log -- -W missing_docs -W missing_debug_implementations -W clippy::missing_errors_doc -W clippy::missing_panics_doc -W clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason -W clippy::dbg_macro -W clippy::todo -W clippy::unimplemented -W clippy::wildcard_imports -W clippy::missing_assert_message -W clippy::map_err_ignore -W clippy::too_long_first_doc_paragraph > /work/tmp/audit.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -15 /work/tmp/audit.log
exit "$status"

cd /work/crate
sed -n '240,410p' quinn-proto/src/config/transport.rs
cat quinn-proto/src/token_memory_cache.rs
cat quinn-proto/src/cid_generator.rs
cat quinn-proto/src/varint.rs
cat quinn-proto/src/coding.rs

sed -n '510,850p' quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/state.rs

grep -nE '^    pub fn|assert!|unwrap|expect|panic!' quinn-proto/src/connection/mod.rs

sed -n '810,960p' quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/state.rs

cargo test --locked -p quinn-proto --no-default-features > /work/tmp/no-default.log 2>&1
first_status=$?
tail -30 /work/tmp/no-default.log
cargo test --locked -p quinn-proto --features qlog,arbitrary,platform-verifier,rustls-log > /work/tmp/extended.log 2>&1

tail -30 /work/tmp/extended.log
printf 'no-default exit: %s; extended exit: %s\n' "$first_status" "$second_status"

grep -nA35 -B10 'pub fn set_priority' quinn/src/send_stream.rs

s=open('/work/tmp/audit.log').read()

for msg,n in counts.items(): print(n,msg)

for b in s:
 if any(x in b for x in ['unsafe block','does not implement','missing `# Panics`']): print(b+'\n')

for name in ['Errors', 'Panics']:
 print(name, s.count('missing `# '+name+'` section'))
